goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Repository reality supports one coherent Worker package. The strict canonical-ID reducer, deterministic compiler, and native preview already exist; the missing protocol, sole-writer service, SQLite store, CLI, SSE, and durable editor path are tightly coupled and share files, so splitting at service scaffolding would create the documented misfire. Use built-in node:sqlite on the verified Node 22.22.3 Darwin arm64 runtime and /usr/bin/lockf for the pre-listen advisory lock. Keep a fixed main head only; branch creation, claims, replay hardening, and Phase 4+ remain excluded.
evidence: Architecture lines 312-320 define this exact end-to-end slice and exclude branch creation and claims; lines 321-329 defer those controls and refresh hardening.
The runtime is Node v22.22.3 on Darwin arm64; node:sqlite DatabaseSync was successfully exercised, no SQLite package is locked, and /usr/bin/lockf supports nonblocking pre-listen locking.
The domain already provides strict expected-revision, operation-ID, canonical-ID motion.track.create reduction and deterministic canonical bytes.
The compiler and NativePreviewController already produce and mount exact browser-native HTML/CSS using iframe.srcdoc and browser-created animations.
The editor currently owns an in-memory AuthoringState and calls the reducer directly; no shared client, immutable service refetch, or SSE subscription exists.
No protocol, ProjectStore, SQLite service, CLI, recovery, parity, or Phase 3 scripts currently exist.
The exact current-worktree nonvisual command passed 8 files and 134 tests; typecheck and build also passed. The broad packages-glob unit command is not an authoritative gate.
Top risks are hidden/non-atomic writers, crash or lost-response idempotency failure, and editor/CLI/refresh drift or private leakage; the Worker verification directly tests each.

worker_package.objective: Implement and prove the complete first Phase 3 durable authoring path as one vertical package: wrap the existing canonical-ID motion.track.create operation in one shared motion.protocol.v1 schema/client; run one /usr/bin/lockf -kn protected loopback service as the only SQLite owner; persist a checksummed fixed-main seed, immutable revisions, private events, request digests, canonical digests, stored sanitized responses, and head advancement atomically through a first-slice ProjectStore using node:sqlite BEGIN IMMEDIATE, foreign_keys=ON, WAL, and synchronous=FULL; provide stable errors and CLI exit codes; invoke the same client through the actual CLI and editor; publish metadata only after commit; refetch the immutable revision and remount exact compiler output; prove concurrency, rejection invariance, idempotency, restart/lost-response behavior, editor/CLI byte parity, Chrome refresh, privacy, and protected-diff safety. Do not implement branch creation, claims, replay hardening, dirty-draft reconciliation, Phase 4+, or a second persistent writer.
verify: repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && npm exec vitest -- run --root "$repo_root" "$repo_root/packages/domain/src/domain.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/domain/src/authoring.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/domain/src/repository-safety.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/css-import/src/import.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/css-import/src/materialize.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/css-compiler/src/determinism.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/preview-runtime/src/index.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/visual-proof/src/index.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/motion-protocol/src/index.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/local-service/src/service.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/local-service/src/recovery.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/phase3-proof/src/parity.test.ts" "$repo_root/packages/phase3-proof/src/privacy.test.ts" --sequence.concurrent false

git diff --exit-code -- package-lock.json AGENTS.md docs/architecture/phase3-persistence-boundary.md docs/incubation-plan.md fixtures packages/css-import packages/css-compiler packages/preview-runtime packages/visual-proof scripts
stop_if: node:sqlite cannot satisfy the required file-backed transaction, WAL, FULL synchronous, backup, or restart semantics on the locked Node >=22.22 runtime.
/usr/bin/lockf -kn cannot hold the store-adjacent advisory lock across the service child lifetime or cannot reject a second service before it listens.
Implementation would require a SQLite npm dependency, package-lock.json change, generalized store-adapter ecosystem, or any SQLite import outside packages/local-service/src/sqlite-project-store.ts.
Implementation requires branch creation, claims, leases, SSE replay, dirty-draft reconciliation, MCP, Lineage integration, video, publication, Phase 4+, or another persistent writer.
The editor, CLI, compiler, or preview would open SQLite, use localStorage/indexedDB, persist a canonical document, or treat an unfetched client projection as committed truth.
A private fixture, corpus path, tracked database/WAL/backup/discovery artifact, raw payload receipt, credential, URL, selector, absolute path, or screenshot would be required.
Existing visual or deterministic proof must be weakened, deleted, skipped, or replaced to make the new gate pass.
Required work falls outside the exact allowed_files list.
A focused verification command fails twice for the same unresolved product cause.
